info.title: Crow HR API
info.description: Versioned REST API used by the Crow HR web app and native apps. Within v1, changes are additive only; see docs/api.md.

get.summary: List out-of-office cover
get.description: Current and upcoming cover involving the caller; hr_admins and owners see everyone's with `all=true`.

post.summary: Set out-of-office cover
post.description: While active, the delegate also receives the member's approval tasks. hr_admins may set it for anyone.

get.summary: List members who can approve or cover
get.description: Active members of the organisation (name only), for delegate and approver pickers.

get.summary: List approval policies per request type
get.description: Types without a stored policy show the built-in default chain.

put.summary: Replace the approval policies of one request type
put.description: Exactly one policy must have no condition (the default). Requests already submitted keep their chain. Policies for payroll runs and profile changes (bank details) are owner-only.

get.summary: List my requests
get.description: Requests the caller submitted, newest first.

get.summary: Get a request with its approval chain
get.description: Visible to the requester, approvers, delegates while their task is open, owners and hr_admins (not payroll runs), and whoever the module's `canRead` allows.

post.summary: Comment on a request
Withdraw my pending request

get.summary: List my open approval tasks
get.description: Pending tasks assigned to the caller, including delegated, escalated and reassigned ones.

post.summary: Approve or reject several tasks
post.description: Each task is decided in its own transaction; the result lists the outcome per task.

post.summary: Approve or reject a task
post.description: Idempotent: repeating the same decision returns `replayed: true`. A task that someone else already decided answers 409 `already_decided` with who decided and when.

post.summary: Reassign a pending task
Add a missing punch to someone's timesheet, with a reason (audited)

post.summary: Clock in or out (idempotent: a retried key returns the original punch with 200)
post.description: Send `deviceTime` (the tap) and `sentAt` (device clock when sending). The server records its own time and the corrected time, and flags clock skew and late sync. Queued offline punches are sent in order with `queued: true`.

post.summary: Void a wrong punch, with a reason (the original is kept; audited)

get.summary: Sign-in methods an organisation has enabled
get.description: Public. Without `org`, resolves the only organisation of a single-organisation install.

post.summary: Complete a sign-in with a TOTP or recovery code
post.description: Completes a password sign-in (token from `/auth/sign-in`) or an SSO sign-in that needs Crow HR's TOTP (token in the `crowhr_mfa` cookie set by the SSO callback; omit `mfaToken`). Wrong codes count toward the account's MFA lock; requests are also limited per network.

get.summary: Identity provider callback
get.description: The only cookie-authenticated GET with side effects; protected by `state`. Validates the ID token (signature, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce) and the provider restrictions, links or matches the identity, then signs in.

302.description: Redirect into the app, or back to the sign-in page with an error.

get.summary: Relying-party public keys for a provider (Singpass)
Start single sign-on with a provider
get.description: Redirects to the identity provider (authorization code + PKCE S256, state and nonce kept server-side for 10 minutes). `purpose=test` is an owner's test sign-in; `purpose=link` links the provider to the signed-in user.

post.summary: Set a new password from a reset link
post.description: Single use. Revokes every session and device of the user.

post.summary: Check a password reset link before showing the form
Request a password reset email
post.description: Always answers 202, whether or not the email belongs to a member.

post.summary: Confirm it's you before a sensitive action
post.description: Password sessions: password, plus a TOTP or recovery code when MFA is enrolled. SSO sessions re-authenticate by an SSO round-trip instead.

401.description: Error: invalid_credentials, invalid_mfa_code, session_expired, session_revoked, unauthenticated.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Every failure (unknown email, wrong password, suspended, locked) answers the same 401 invalid_credentials. When MFA is enrolled the response carries a pending-sign-in token instead of a session.

post.summary: Sign out of this browser session
Switch the session to another organisation you belong to
post.description: Issues a new session token (rotation) scoped to the target organisation.

get.summary: List my notifications
get.description: Every response carries `cursor`, the position of the newest item in this view. Pass it back as `since` to get only newer notifications, oldest first (`sort` is then ignored); `cursor` then points at the last item returned, so a client pages forward with it until `items` is empty. `cursor` is null only when there is nothing to point at.
